reviewer.observation_limit: The reviewer session ID and runtime model were not independently observed. The reviewed campaign configuration requests gpt-6-astra / ultra; this is not a claim about this audit session.

scope: Bounded technical review of prepared method, allocation, queue, schema, preparation script and supplied input files. No philosophical assessment, research dispatch, runner review or source re-verification.

checks.detail: BASELINE_DECISIONS.json equals the accepted final-preselection register; it contains 22 unique candidates, each with exactly one current version.
Each allocation selects the exact current baseline version. Source SHA-256 and byte size match the register; each blinded manuscript is byte-identical to its source.
All protected historical/current files match the recorded SHA-256 and byte size.
110 unique job IDs and matching packet files; each of the 22 manuscripts has exactly N1, N2, N3, J1 and J2. No omitted or extra packet/job found.

Every packet was reconstructed exactly from RUBRIC.txt, review identity, common schema, the assigned profile materials and complete assigned manuscript. Packet hashes, schema hashes and declared source lists match.
Reproducing the fixed-seed candidate/profile shuffle yields the saved allocation. Each manuscript receives two distinct named profiles. All 23 profiles are covered: 21 twice and two once.
All assigned profile inputs are included intact and have matching hashes. No manuscript-specific previous scores or decisions were found in the reviewed profile materials.

Packets do not include BASELINE_DECISIONS, essay histories, prior essay assessments, source manuscript paths, original candidate IDs, author/model labels or global navigation files. Manuscript boundaries contain titles, manuscript text and bibliographies; no administrative preface or trailing report was found.

All complete source bytes and bibliographies are present. Manuscript sizes range from 13,342 to 34,611 bytes; packet sizes range from 18,152 to 50,043 bytes. The short Russian E100 source is reproduced intact, not truncated.
All queued jobs use the declared model gpt-6-astra, effort ultra and service tier default.

Neutral and named-profile roles receive the same contribution, argument, significance and provisional-originality criteria. 60% of the mean of three neutral reviews plus 40% of the mean of two profile reviews gives each completed review one-fifth weight. Reasons and checked objections control final decisions rather than automatic score ranking.
METHOD.json: 110 individual reviews plus at most 10 pairs with five reviews each equals 160.
STATE_000_PREPARED.json declares 110 individual jobs and maximum_total 160, consistent with METHOD.json.

Schema JSON parses and its requested fields, score ranges and review structure match the rubric. A third-party JSON Schema validator was unavailable in the inspected Python environment; no formal validator-library certification is claimed.

limits: Actual fresh-session isolation, native prompt delivery, tool exclusion, runtime model/effort and archive acceptance were outside this audit and require runner/transport verification.

The schema alone permits read_complete=false, arbitrary review/manuscript/profile identifiers and empty strings. Result acceptance must verify the expected IDs, honest full reading and substantive completion separately.

Source-access notes are preserved within the frozen manuscripts. Some describe assigned captures, supplied parsed text or inherited source descriptions. The coordinator expressly accepted preserving these honest access limits; they do not disclose author/model identity or previous scores.

Profile materials retain provenance and historical calibration limitations about constructing the profiles. These are not prior assessments of the candidate manuscripts and do not establish fidelity to actual judges.
Public source accuracy, complete novelty and philosophical merit were not assessed. No claim of complete contamination detection beyond the checked files and observed metadata patterns is made.
Pair jobs are intentionally not prepared before individual results. Their distinct-pair limit, 3:2 composition, frozen allocation and balanced A/B order still need verification when created.
No blocking method defect was identified within this bounded review. No research role or test session was launched, and no input file was changed.
write_scope: Only METHOD_CHECK.json was created for this audit record; all verification described above had already been completed before the follow-up save request.
